title: Cloudflare Launches Full Modality Clef-omni for Audio and Video Processing

tickers.name: Cloudflare, Inc. Class A common stock, par value $0.001 per share

summary:
The internet infrastructure firm introduced a multimodal AI tool that interprets sound and moving imagery alongside standard text and images. This new model, known as Clef-omni, is already being used by internal teams to identify PII, detect malicious domains, and manage spam issues in documentation repositories. Simultaneously, the company reduced the cost of its Clef-flash model to $0.038 per million input tokens.

The release expands the Clef family by introducing full-modality capabilities for the first time. Beyond the launch of the omni model, Cloudflare increased the general processing speed of its existing Clef tools to improve performance for developers and enterprises.
